shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in app/*; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "ls -la .next/server/app && node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('.next/server/app').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.html'))) {const s=fs.readFileSync('.next/server/app/'+f,'utf8'); console.log(f, ['Dashboard','Total Revenue','Total Invoices','Revenue','Latest Invoices','Loading...'].map(x=>x+': '+s.includes(x)).join(', '))}\""
